oracle.invariant: Exit 0, 0 failures. The internal guest session is minted again after SESSION_RENEW_AFTER_S or within 5 minutes of its end, once for concurrent calls; a process 72 h old still answers anonymous calls. GET /widget/api/state without a cookie sets no cookie and keeps no visitor; the first write makes one; the 21st new visitor from one address in an hour answers 429 WIDGET_VISITOR_LIMIT; a full map drops the idle anonymous visitor used longest ago, and with every visitor busy answers 503 WIDGET_AT_CAPACITY with Retry-After 30. Two anonymous visitors speak under two widget-guest+<hmac16>@widget.invalid identities: one's microphone never ends the other's session, each has its own day, and the widget-anonymous bucket stops them all at its own limit. The cron job deletes expired widget_conversation rows in batches.
